mentions.name: icloudpd-rs
mentions.description: A fast iCloud Photos downloader rewritten from scratch in Rust as a replacement for the unmaintained Python icloudpd. It supports parallel downloads, SQLite state tracking, and resumable transfers, delivering 5x faster download speeds in benchmarks while shipping as a single binary with Docker and Homebrew packaging.
mentions.problem: The original Python icloudpd is looking for a new maintainer, leaving the tool without active maintenance.
mentions.source_excerpt:
icloudpd-rs - Fast iCloud Photos downloader, Rust alternative to icloudpd

The original Python icloudpd is looking for a new maintainer. I’ve been building a ground-up Rust replacement with parallel downloads, SQLite state tracking, and resumable transfers. 5x faster downloads in benchmarks, single binary, Docker and Homebrew ready.
